title: Saturn Has a Six-Sided Storm Wider Than Two Earths

scenes.text: Saturn has a six-sided storm wider than two Earths.
It sits on the north pole and spans about 20,000 miles.
Winds inside it blow around 200 miles an hour.
Voyager spotted it in the early 1980s. Decades later, Cassini photographed it again.
It's still there, with six straight sides.
Wider than two Earths. Six sides.

description:
Saturn's north pole has a six-sided jet stream about 20,000 miles across, with winds around 200 miles an hour.
Voyager spotted it in the early 1980s and it's still there.
What do you think makes six sides?
first_comment: A six-sided storm the size of two Earths. What's the weirdest thing you've seen in space?
